- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended several music festivals in California, including:
  - Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival: Takes place in Indio, California, usually over two weekends in April.
  - Outside Lands Music and Arts Festival: Held in San Francisco's Golden Gate Park in August.
  - BottleRock Napa Valley: A five-day festival in May in Napa Valley.
  - Electric Daisy Carnival (EDC) California: Takes place in June at the Las Vegas Motor Speedway.
  - Monterey Jazz Festival: A three-day festival in September.
  - Hardly Strictly Bluegrass: A free festival in San Francisco's Golden Gate Park in October.
  - Aftershock Festival: A two-day festival in October in Sacramento.
